title: World Bank's IFC to Invest ₹225 Crore ($23 Million) in NDR Smart Spaces Warehousing
summary: International Finance Corporation (IFC) to invest ₹225 crore ($23M) equity in NDR Smart Spaces for Grade A warehousing across MH, TN, UP.

blocks.content: International Finance Corporation (IFC) to invest ₹225 crore ($23M) equity in NDR Smart Spaces for Grade A warehousing across MH, TN, UP.

items: **Equity Investment:** IFC investing **₹225 crore (~$23 million)** in NDR Smart Spaces Pvt Ltd.
**Infrastructure Focus:** Developing Grade A warehousing and logistics infrastructure in **Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh**.
